title: CatalogCategoryChangedPayload
description: Payload of `catalog.category.changed` version 1: a category of a store's catalogue changed. The envelope's `partner_id` is the store's partner. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

category_id.description: The category; for `reordered`, the first category of the new order.

change.description: What kind of change: the category `created`, `updated`, `deleted` or `duplicated` (the copy is the category named), the categories `reordered`, or the `items` on it.

revision.description: The catalogue's revision after the change, raised by every change; the version of the `catalog.changed` signal on the store's catalogue channel.
